notes.title: Ancient Internals
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=Z75zzjViGPM;full][/previewyoutube]

With the help of the community, we have uncovered something amazing: an official level pack for Action SuperCross, made from previously unreleased and early versions of levels.

You'll get this pack for free if you get Action SuperCross on Steam, launching in 4 days, on June 17!

You can find the item on the Steam Workshop.

Very special thanks to
- Schumi for organizing this effort
- sunl for development support
- iCS for creating the trailer
